title: Cardinality of the space of vectors over $\mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$
statement:
Let $k$ and $n$ be natural numbers with $k \ge 1$. The set $(\mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z})^n$ of $n$-tuples with entries in $\mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$ is finite, and its cardinality is
\[
\bigl|(\mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z})^n\bigr| = k^n.
\]
hypotheses_covered: k ≥ 1 (k nonzero, so ℤ/kℤ is a finite type of size k)
n a natural number (dimension of the vector space)
replaced:
For $k \geq 1$, the finite type $\texttt{ZkFourier.ZkVec}\ k\ n$ has
$|\mathbb{Z}_k^n| = k^n$ elements.
